author: bardic-inspiration
name: Bottled Thunder
summary: A glass sphere that releases a thunderclap when thrown.
description: The sphere rumbles faintly when shaken. Cave-divers carry them to warn off things that live in the dark.

stats.effect: As a Magic action, you can throw this sphere at a point within 30 feet. Each creature within 10 feet of that point makes a DC 14 Constitution saving throw, taking 3d6 Thunder damage and having the {ref:condition/deafened} condition until the end of its next turn on a failed save, or half as much damage and no condition on a success. The sphere is consumed.
